title: Moving Beyond the DRW Model: Learning Quasar Variability with Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.15040v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The optical continuum variability of quasars is often described by a damped random walk (DRW) model, with characteristic damping timescales $\tau_{\rm DRW}$ of hundreds of days and amplitudes $\sigma_{\rm DRW}$ of $\mathcal{O}(0.1)$ magnitudes. This model has been widely used as a null hypothesis to assess the significance of periodic signals in quasar light curves in the search for supermassive black hole binaries, the significance of extreme quasar variability like tidal disruption events (TDEs) and changing-look (CL) quasars, or to model time lags in reverberation mapping. However, the DRW model is known to be incomplete, and an incorrect null hypothesis can lead to biased significance estimates. We investigate the impact of such null-hypothesis mis-specification on the detection of periodic signals in synthetic quasar light curves and introduce the generative model Nullasar, capable of learning quasar variability directly from time

translated_title: 超越DRW模型：利用生成模型学习类星体变率
translated_abstract: 类星体的光学连续谱变率通常用阻尼随机游走（DRW）模型来描述，其特征阻尼时标为数百天，振幅约为0.1星等量级。该模型已被广泛用作零假设，用于评估类星体光变曲线中周期性信号的显著性（以搜寻超大质量黑洞双星）、极端类星体变率现象（如潮汐瓦解事件TDE和变脸类星体CL）的显著性，或在反响映射中对时间延迟进行建模。然而，众所周知DRW模型是不完备的，而错误的零假设可能导致有偏差的显著性估计。我们研究了这种零假设错误设定对合成类星体光变曲线中周期性信号检测的影响，并引入了生成模型Nullasar，该模型能够直接从时间序列数据中学习类星体的变率特性。
tldr: 本文提出名为Nullasar的生成模型，可直接从时间序列数据中学习类星体变率特性，以克服DRW模型作为零假设不完备所导致的显著性估计偏差问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Nullasar, a generative model that learns quasar variability directly from time-series data, addressing biased significance estimates caused by the incomplete DRW null hypothesis.
